error.title: Companion app unreachable
error.customUrlLabel: Is the companion app running at a different address?

idle.robotsCheckTitle: Checks the page's robots.txt to see whether this URL is allowed for crawlers
idle.combinedHint: Merges several of your own already-saved configurations — even from different sites — into one script whose outputs are combined into a single result.
idle.combinedNoSavedConfigsHint: No saved configurations yet — save at least two configurations first (in another mode), then combine them here.
idle.apiCaptureTitle: Records this page's fetch/XHR network requests
idle.apiSearchTitle: Then click a data point on the page — it will be searched for in the recording
idle.apiEmbeddedJsonSearchTitle: For sites with no separate network request: click a data point and it will be searched for in the page's own <script> tags (e.g. __NEXT_DATA__)
idle.apiEntriesTitle: Shows every network request recorded so far, with URL, method and status
idle.previewTitle: Shows directly on the page which elements the current configuration would match
idle.exportConfigTitle: Export the current fields/containers as JSON — e.g. for a bug report
idle.saveConfigTitle: Save the current configuration locally, so it can be reloaded next time this site is scraped
idle.savedConfigsEmpty: No saved configurations for this site yet.
idle.savedOutputsEmpty: No saved outputs for this configuration yet.
idle.hardeningReplayNoChecks: No hardening checks are currently configured — set one up in the Monitoring section first.
idle.hardeningReplayCompareBasisLabel: This check needs a previous result to compare against:
idle.engineBrowserTitle: Renders JavaScript before extraction — for dynamically loaded pages or login flows. Slower than the static engine.
idle.outputFileToggle: Download the full scraped data file
idle.additionalUrlsPlaceholder: One URL per line (in addition to the page above)
idle.changeDetectionHint: Every field here is the name of an environment variable, not the value itself — the real value is read from the environment at the actual run, never written into the script.
idle.proxyHint: The name of an environment variable holding a comma-separated list of proxy URLs (e.g. "http://user:pass@host:port"), not the addresses themselves — with more than one, the script rotates through them per request.
idle.externalConfigHint: Lets you tweak the start URL(s), the output filename, a field's output name, or a fixed-value-list API parameter's values later, by editing a small XML file — without touching the .py file or reopening the extension. The file doesn't exist yet; the script creates it next to itself the first time it actually runs.
idle.paginationUrlTemplateHint: Must contain both {url} (the start page, unchanged) and {page} (the page number, starting at 2 — page 1 is always the start page as-is).
idle.discoveredUrlsHint: Loads this page once and adds every link matching the selector, in addition to the URL above and any additional start URLs.
idle.discoveredUrlsMaxUrlsLabel: Max. number of discovered URLs (safety limit)
idle.hardeningSeverityWarningTitle: The script prints a warning but still exits with code 0.
idle.hardeningSeverityErrorTitle: The script prints an error and exits with its own code (2), distinguishable from a crash (1).
idle.hardeningNullRateSectionLabel: Check for empty values per field
idle.hardeningBaselineToggle: Check for a drop vs. the last run
idle.hardeningBlockingToggle: Check for blocking (redirect, short response, block phrases)
idle.hardeningBlockingPhrasesPlaceholder: e.g. "Access Denied", "Please verify you are human"
idle.preflightToggle: Check beforehand whether the page has changed, and skip the run if not
idle.preflightHint: Sends a quick request to the page before the real scrape starts. If nothing has changed since the last run, or the page isn't reachable right now, the run is skipped without the cost of a full scrape.
idle.blocksHint: Builds several independent extraction blocks (flat or container, freely mixed) sharing this page’s navigation — each writes its own output file in one script run.
idle.blocksMinCountHint: At least 2 blocks are required to generate a script.
idle.outputBlueprintMappingHint: Map each target field to one of this configuration's own source fields — every target field needs a source before the script can be generated.
idle.outputBlueprintTreeMappingHint: Map each target field to one of this configuration's own source fields — a target group's own position in the output is inferred automatically from its mapped fields. Every target field needs a source before the script can be generated.

robots.notFound: No robots.txt found — access is allowed.

selecting.hint: Click an element on the page…
selecting.domTreeError: The tree could not be loaded.

apiConfig.embeddedJsonSourceNote: Sourced from embedded JSON in the page's own <script> tag ({selector}) — the URL below is the page to fetch, not a JSON API endpoint.
apiConfig.insertParameterHint: Inserts the placeholder at the end (or at the cursor position if you just clicked into the field) — move it yourself to the right spot in the path afterward, where a fixed value would otherwise go, e.g. ".../categories/{category}/weeks".
apiConfig.valueListPlaceholder: Values, comma-separated or one per line
apiConfig.autoFillFromPoolTitle: Searches the recorded request pool for other calls with the same URL shape and adds their differing values to the list
apiConfig.autoFillNoMatches: No further values found in the recording.
apiConfig.bodyCoerceToTitle: Value type to use in the body (default: text)

apiBootstrap.toggleLabel: Fetch a fresh token before every run (auth bootstrap)
apiBootstrap.hint: For APIs that need a short-lived token from a login/token request first. The script sends that request at the start of every run and uses the extracted value in the headers/URL below — credentials only ever come from environment variables.
apiBootstrap.recordingHint: Pick the login/token request. Not listed? Keep recording, reload the page (or log in again), then reopen this list.
apiBootstrap.recordingEmpty: No recorded request with a JSON response found.
apiBootstrap.recordingLikely: token used by the main request
apiBootstrap.recordingApplied: Token request adopted — value read from "{path}".
apiBootstrap.recordingNoValuePath: Token request adopted, but the token's JSON path couldn't be detected — please enter it.
apiBootstrap.bodyFieldsLabel: Body fields of the token request
apiBootstrap.valuePathLabel: JSON path to the token in the response
apiBootstrap.usageHint: Use {placeholder} in a header ("From token" mode, e.g. Bearer {placeholder}) or pick "Token value" as the value source of a URL part. Discovery requests reuse the headers.
apiBootstrap.sourceKindNote: Filled with the freshly fetched token ({placeholder}) on every run.
apiBootstrap.sourceKindMissing: No auth bootstrap configured — enable it above or pick another value source.

done.title: Script generated successfully!
done.dataPreviewTruncatedXml: Excerpt — not all data is shown

settings.title: Settings
settings.scriptNameHostnameHint: The script name is always derived from the current website's hostname.

fieldExtended.downloadToggle: Download this resource/file (e.g. an image, PDF, or ZIP) and save it locally

apiGroupNew.pathLabel: JSON path (relative to the parent scope, e.g. "subcategories")

combineField.sourcesLabel: Which fields should be combined? (at least 2)
combineField.removeOriginalsToggle: Remove the original fields from the output

splitField.removeOriginalToggle: Remove the original field from the output

saveOutput.noConfigsHint: No saved configuration for this site yet — name one below and it will be created and linked to this output.

blueprintEdit.importPlaceholder: Paste a JSON sample, a CSV header row, or one field name per line…

toast.combinedComponentUnresolvable: Component "{name}" could not be loaded — its saved configuration may have been deleted.
toast.selectionUnavailable: Element selection isn't possible on this page.
toast.scopeSelectorNotFound: The selected reference point could no longer be found — the page changed in the meantime (e.g. a hover or loading state). Please try again or pick a different starting point.
toast.clickOutsideScope: Please select an element inside a container.
toast.trackedUrlUpdated: Tracked page updated to {url} — the element you just picked came from a different page than before.
toast.previewUnavailable: Preview isn't possible on this page.
toast.captureUnavailable: Network recording isn't possible on this page.
toast.invalidCompanionUrl: Invalid address — please include http:// or https://.
toast.blueprintImportEmpty: Could not find any field names in the pasted sample.
toast.blueprintImportFileReadFailed: Could not read the selected file: {message}

browserActions.title: Browser actions
browserActions.hint: Run in order before extraction, e.g. for a login flow.
browserActions.envVarHint: The value is read from this environment variable at runtime, never stored in the script.
browserActions.testValueHint: Used only for the one-time trial run when generating — never stored, never included in the script.
browserActions.persistentSessionHint: Saves cookies/login state after each run and skips the login actions above on the next run. Warning: the saved file contains live session cookies — treat it like a password and never share or commit it. If the session ever expires, the run simply fails; there is no automatic re-login.
